items.title: Write reviewable cli-engine English translation execution plan
items.context: Audit packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts for Chinese-language surfaces and create an English execution document with per-item Chinese-to-English translation results for reviewer approval. Do not change CLI source in this story.
items.userSees: The document opens with "# CLI Engine English Open-Source Surface Execution Plan" and includes a "Translation Review Table" section.

happy.desc: The new execution document exists and states the English-only open-source policy, staged migration plan, verification commands, and reviewer workflow.

edge.desc: The document includes a Chinese source to proposed English translation table for cli-engine.ts review, including representative public CLI help/schema/error/hint surfaces.

adversarial.desc: This documentation story does not modify packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts or the existing untracked lattice-codex command boundary document.

excludes: Do not modify packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts in this documentation-only story.
Do not modify the existing untracked docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-codex-command-boundary-execution-plan.md file.
Do not run omx or read/write/use .omx/.
Do not directly edit docs/story/ or packages/main/tests/fixtures/.
Do not translate README or the wider docs set in this story; only create the review execution document.

verificationEvidence.command: test -f docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md && rg -n "English-Only Policy|Execution Phases|Complete Line-Level Translation Manifest|Reviewer Checklist" docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The execution document exists and now includes the English-only policy, staged execution plan, complete line-level manifest, and reviewer checklist.

The document now has a complete line-level translation manifest: all 762 Chinese-bearing cli-engine.ts lines are present, every row has proposedEnglish, proposedEnglish has no Chinese, and no fallback placeholder remains.
The change set remains documentation/Lattice metadata only; packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts and docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-codex-command-boundary-execution-plan.md were not modified.

auditLog.reason: Begin writing the reviewable English translation execution plan document.
